title: Waqf in Ya-Sin 60 to 64: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Waqf in Ya-Sin 60 to 64 rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 36. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Starting with hamzat al-wasl
points: Verb with dammah on the third letter: start with u

arabic.text: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ (٦٠) وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ (٦١) وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ (٦٢) هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ (٦٣) ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ (٦٤)

keywords.def: stopping on a word, with a breath
a connecting hamza, pronounced only when starting

questions.q: Recite 36:61, stopping at ۚ, then restart «هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ».
Stop map (pupil PDF): mark signs, safe breath points and starting sounds in 36:60 to 64. Today's rota group recites 36:49 to 64.
Extend: label the end of 36:63 tamm or kafi.
Stretch: why does «وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى» have a kasrah on the noon?
questions.a: Two sukoons meet (noon and ع); the noon takes a kasrah to join.

questions.q: Starting at «ٱعْبُدُونِى» (36:61), the first sound is ...
questions.a: A) u. The third letter (ب) has a dammah, so the connecting hamza takes a dammah.

questions.q: Think again: 36:64 begins «ٱصْلَوْهَا». How do you start a word that begins with hamzat al-wasl?
questions.a: With a kasrah, because the third letter has a fathah: islawhaa.
